title: Ohne-Makler Rent Index Scraper
description: Read the Ohne-Makler Mietspiegel for German cities, with rent tables, market sections, and available chart data. Batch city and state pairs to compare reference rents.

batch.title: City and state slugs
batch.description: City and state slugs used to look up an Ohne-Makler rent index.
batch.valueDescription: city slug used for this Mietspiegel lookup.

fixture.title: Mietspiegel Berlin 2026
fixture.intro: Cold rent values by apartment size for the Berlin market.

storeCopy.seoDescription: Get city Mietspiegel data from Ohne-Makler, with rent tables and market sections. Batch city and state pairs to compare local rent reference values.
storeCopy.intro: Retrieve an Ohne-Makler Mietspiegel by city and state slug. The record contains rent-reference sections, tables, available chart information, and locality details.
useCases: Renters can review local rent reference tables before comparing housing costs.
Property owners can compare city-level rent figures across German markets.
Housing analysts can build a dataset of rent-index sections by city.
howToUse: Add each city and its state slug to `cities`.
Set `maxResults` to cap the number of city reports saved.
Export each Mietspiegel response as one dataset record.

faqs.question: Why does every city need a state?
faqs.answer: The source identifies Mietspiegel pages with both a city slug and its state slug, so include both values in each batch entry.
